card.name: Citation and number punctuation in references
card.fires_on: Punctuation, spaces and digits inside reference citations and numbered lists, such as after Ref, inside DOI numbers, and between cited numbers. Also fires on 'observed' after 'range'.

modes.label: Citation marks
modes.description: A period, comma, space or digit inside a reference, DOI or numbered citation.

modes.label: Range observed
modes.description: The word 'observed' right after 'range' when comparing values.
